column1: Xavier Edwards leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a recent uptick in contact, batting second with the platoon edge against Cade Cavalli in a hitter-friendly park. Luis Arraez offers even steadier game-to-game reliability and also holds the matchup advantage, making him a close alternative. Bobby Witt Jr., Freddie Freeman, and Matt Olson round out the top options, all benefiting from favorable splits and lineup spots, but Edwards stands out for consistency and matchup quality.
